heroTitle: Manage your machinery without losing control.
heroDescription: Centralize availability, reservations and maintenance so your machinery rental business can operate faster and with fewer mistakes.
heroNote: Built for small machinery rental businesses and independent contractors.
benefitsTitle: Everything you need to keep your operation organized.
benefitsDescription: Replace scattered spreadsheets, calls and messages with a single source of information.
benefitOneDescription: Quickly identify which machines are available, reserved or under maintenance.
benefitTwoDescription: Keep rental dates organized and reduce conflicts between reservations.
benefitThreeDescription: Know the operational condition of your equipment before confirming a rental.
benefitFourDescription: Access important machinery and rental information from one place.
segmentsTitle: Two sides of the machinery rental process.
segmentOneDescription: Organize your machinery fleet, reservations and maintenance without relying on disconnected spreadsheets and conversations.
segmentTwoDescription: Find the machinery you need and review relevant information before coordinating your next rental.
howDescription: MaquiControl simplifies the most important steps of machinery rental management.
stepOneDescription: Add your equipment and keep its main information organized.
stepTwoDescription: Keep track of reservations, operational status and maintenance.
stepThreeDescription: Respond faster and make better decisions with centralized information.
valueTitle: Your machinery information where you actually need it.
valueDescription: MaquiControl helps small rental businesses reduce manual coordination and gives contractors a clearer way to access machinery information.
pricingTitle: Choose the plan that fits your business.
pricingDescription: Flexible monthly or annual subscriptions based on your fleet size.
essentialDescription: For small machinery rental businesses starting to digitize their operation.
proDescription: For growing rental businesses that manage a larger machinery fleet.
pricingNote: Annual plans include a reduced effective monthly cost. Rental transactions may also include a service commission.
